tex_content.label: Ric>0
tex_content.html:
For a compact connected three-dimensional Ricci flow, $\Ric (x,0)\ge 0$ implies $\Ric (x,t)\ge 0$ for all $x,t$.
Proof

↗ thm:maximum-principle-tensors-global ↗ lem:curvature-operator-ode-dimension-three \sketch Apply the tensor maximum principle to the convex cone of curvature operators whose sum of the two smallest eigenvalues is nonnegative.

□
